text:
jordan: Heads-up: scheduling a tenant_meta index backfill tonight 23:50 UTC. Expect ~40m with the default backfill job. Need a short quiet window and to pin master for the duration.
tiffany: Which shards/tenants? Any special ordering?
jordan: Targets: tenants B1,B2 (shards 2,6,9). Order 2 -> 9 -> 6 (we want to run through the least-loaded first). Concurrency 6, ratecap 200 rows/s per shard.
mateo: Can we run a preflight at 23:40 to check replica lag and QPS before touching anything?
jordan: Yes - 10m preflight. If replica lag > 30s or QPS spike > 2x baseline we'll abort.
ops_oncall: I'm on for the window. Put me an alert 23:35 UTC. Also share the precise rollback steps now so I can validate.
tiffany: Rollback (short):
- deploybot stop-job <job_id>
- set feature flag tenant_backfill_block -> on (blocks workers)
- run scripts/backfill_mark_incomplete.sh --job <job_id>
mateo: Also note: we have a known read-replica lag blip on shard 9 during nightly compaction. If compaction runs during preflight we should delay by 30m.
jordan: Good call. We'll check compaction cron and delay if necessary. I'm pinning release tag v2.15.0 for 1.5h from 23:30 UTC now.
deploy-bot: [info] scheduled preflight for tenant_meta_backfill at 23:40 UTC (initiated by jordan). preflight_id=pfl_20260323_09
ops_oncall: Reminder set.
mateo: Preflight SQLs (run at 23:40):
```
SELECT max(replica_lag_seconds) FROM replica_status WHERE shard_id IN (2,6,9);
SELECT avg(qps) FROM query_metrics WHERE shard_id=9 AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';
```
Expect lag < 15s and qps ~ 120 +/- 20.
deploy-bot: [status] preflight running: replica_lag=18s, shard9_qps=130
jordan: Replica lag is borderline (18s). That's within threshold. But check if compaction job ran recently on shard 9.
mateo: compaction ended 23:25, so we should be clear.
tiffany: OK to proceed to queued start at 23:50 but start with concurrency=4 as a precaution.
jordan: Update job config: concurrency 4, ratecap 150. Command preview:
```
deploybot start-job --job tenant_meta_backfill --concurrency 4 --ratecap 150 --order 2,9,6 --tag v2.15.0
```
ops_oncall: Confirmed pinned release rp-9999. I reviewed rollback steps and they look good.
deploy-bot: [info] job queued: tenant_meta_backfill start_time=23:50 UTC job_id=jb_20260323_09

-- 23:50 UTC --
deploy-bot: [status] job jb_20260323_09 started. shard=2 progress=0%
tiffany: Noting we should warm the KV cache for tenant reads on shard 2. Added warm=true to job config.
jordan: Good. If we see CPU at >80% on db-primary we pause and lower concurrency.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 2 progress 25% (est 24m remaining)
mateo: seeing elevated DB CPU on primary shard 2 at 23:55 (avg 76%). Watching.
jordan: If CPU breaches 82% reduce concurrency to 2 and ratecap 80.
deploy-bot: [update] concurrency updated to 2 for jb_20260323_09 (requested by jordan)
tiffany: smoke verifier (post-shard) running 150-row FK + null-check on 2.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 2 complete. verifier passed 150/150.
ops_oncall: signal:ok for shard 2. No customer errors in logs.

deploy-bot: [status] starting shard 9 backfill
mateo: heads-up: read-replica lag spiking now (23:58) to 45s on shard 9, likely compaction retry.
jordan: Ugh. Pause job immediately. We'll hold until lag < 20s for two consecutive checks (5m apart).
deploy-bot: [action] pausing jb_20260323_09 due to replica_lag=45s (auto-pause rule).
tiffany: Good call. Ops, can you investigate replica lag source?
ops_oncall: Investigating. I'm seeing long-running vacuum/analyze on replica. Not sure why it's blocking replication. Kicking off an alert to infra-db.
mateo: If we can't bring lag down in 20m we should reschedule the remaining shards to tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
jordan: Agreed. Let's attempt to resume after 10m with reduced concurrency=1 and ratecap=50 as a last-resort if infra says it's safe.
-- 00:10 UTC --
ops_oncall: Infra reports the replica caught up at 00:07. replica_lag=8s. They killed the noisy vacuum.
jordan: Ok attempt resume with low-impact settings: concurrency=1, ratecap=50 for shard9.
deploy-bot: [update] resuming jb_20260323_09 with concurrency=1 ratecap=50
deploy-bot: [status] shard 9 progress 12%
tiffany: running extended verifier on shard 9 (500 rows) after completion due to prior lag.
mateo: We saw two FK mismatches in sample at 00:22 on shard9. Re-running sample to confirm.
mateo: Re-run shows 2/500 fail still. They look like user rows referencing deleted accounts.
jordan: Two failing rows in 500 is 0.4% - within our tolerance (we set 1% for this job). But because it's FK-related, we should record and continue, not abort. Add fix-it ticket.
ops_oncall: Agree. Create ticket and tag data-team. I will hold on abort.
iffany: Creating ticket now: DM-4578. Add SQL snippet and sample row ids.

-- 00:40 UTC --
deploy-bot: [status] shard 9 complete. verifier reported 498/500 pass, 2 flagged. starting shard 6 backfill
mateo: shard 6 progressing; DB IO is a bit high. If IO > 85% for 3 consecutive minutes, hit the pause.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 6 progress 60%
mateo: verifier running early sample for shard 6. Found 0/200 failures.
ops_oncall: All signals look stable. If last verifier passes, we can mark job successful and unpin after 30m observation.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 6 complete. job jb_20260323_09 finished at 00:47 UTC. total elapsed ~57m
jordan: Excellent. Leaving release pin until 01:17 UTC (30m). Sam, please unpin after then.
ops_oncall: observation window started. No customer-facing incidents. Logging verifier outputs to runbook.
tiffany: I'll prepare a brief notes summary and include the DM-4578 ticket ref and the small FK anomaly details.
mateo: Post-action items: longer-term, we should add pre-backfill referential read to catch late-delete races. Filing DM-4579 for that.
jordan: Thanks team. Closing thread. Keep the verifier logs in the runbook and we'll write a short postmortem if DM-4578 needs follow-up. :white_check_mark:
